02 / A LITTLE PERSPECTIVE

A clear head.
A considered next step.

Before any borrowing decision, start with the things that matter.

See the whole picture.

The amount, the costs, the repayment date. Take time to understand the full commitment.

Make room for real life.

Think about your everyday expenses and what a repayment would mean for your budget.

Ask the questions.

Something unclear? Get the information you need before deciding what comes next.

03 / GOOD QUESTIONS

A little clarity
goes a long way.

✳
Can I apply for a loan here?+

This is a first look at Buddy Loans. Applications are not open on this page yet.

What are the loan amounts and costs?+

The product details are still being finalised. Confirmed amounts, costs, repayment periods, and eligibility information will be added before applications open.

Does exploring this page affect my credit?+

No credit check is performed by this preview. The interactive examples do not submit a loan application or assess your eligibility.

Do I need to share personal information?+

No. You can explore this page without entering personal or financial information.
